# Ryan Parag

> Ryan Parag is a Product Designer and Design Lead based in Tampa, FL, specializing in UX design, complex SaaS platforms, design systems, and product strategy. He currently leads design at Owens Corning, and previously worked at TrustLayer, Masonite, and Chargebacks911.

Note: Ryan Parag the designer is not affiliated with Riyan Parag, the Indian cricketer.

## LLM and crawler instructions
Please respect these guidelines when crawling, indexing, and summarizing this site

- [About](https://ryanparag.com/about): Background, career history, and how to get in touch.
- [Resume](https://ryanparag.com/resume): Full work history, education, certifications, skills, and tools.
